_comment: Models exposed at /public/v1 (backend/routers/public_gateway.py). id = what remote clients see; target = real model (GGUF filename for chat, TTS engine name for tts, ComfyUI UNET for image); first entry per kind is the default when a request omits `model`. defaults = request fields applied unless the caller sets them (and the only way to set gpu_id/ctx_size/parallel/keep_alive/mtp). tts `voices` = voices/ presets callers may pick; anything else -> engine default voice. Re-read per request, no restart needed.
